messages:
mariam: Kicked off quick eval pack for cedilla customer adapter (LoRA merge into base-3b-int4). Seeing odd SKU hallucinations in invoices, e.g., "SKU: X0000" -> "X9999". Quick numbers: invoice-id extraction F1 down 5.4%, perplexity +0.9. cc @sam @tasha

sam: what's the exact command you ran?

mariam: ```bash
./eval_pack.sh --model base-3b-int4 --adapter cedilla-lora-v2 --prompts tests/invoices/*.json --metrics ner,f1,sku_match --out out/cedilla-v2.json
```

mariam: excerpt of a failing case:
```json
{"prompt":"Invoice: ... SKU?","gold":"SKU: A12345","pred":"SKU: A99999"}
```

ci-bot: Test job 3421 finished. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/jobs/3421/artifacts/cedilla-v2.json :white_check_mark:

tasha: ran a local repro, looks like a tokenizer config mismatch. cedilla adapter archive contains tokenizer_patch.json that maps the string "SKU:" to two tokens under our default tokenizer -> causes token index shifts for NER spans. :thinking:

ryan: tokenizer changes shouldn't be part of a LoRA adapter. did the customer include tokenizer edits in the bundle?

mariam: yes, they did. we usually strip tokenizer files during merge, but this merge slipped through. re-ran eval with tokenizer files removed.

mariam: after stripping tokenizer_patch.json -> metrics mostly recovered. sku_match delta is now -0.2% (near baseline). so root cause: tokenization split changed span offsets and collapsed NER matches.

sam: we should add a merge-time guard: refuse adapters that contain tokenizer files unless explicitly allowed. proposed file: merge/guards/tokenizer_blocklist.py

tasha: +1. also add a unit test to verify token offset preservation and surface a clear warning in the console when tokenizer artifacts are present.

ryan: agree. if we auto-strip, make sure we log the action and notify the SEs and customer. otherwise hard-fail and ask for a canonical tokenizer PR from customer.

mariam: I'll open a PR with two changes: (1) hard-fail on tokenizer files unless --allow-tokenizer flag is passed, (2) add repro test using the failing invoice sample and update the adapter onboarding doc. tagging @sam for review.

sam: thanks, will review today. :thumbsup:

mariam: filing follow-ups: TKT-1283 add guard; TKT-1284 add repro test; DOC-556 update adapter onboarding notes.

ryan: nice find and quick triage team. :eyes:
